(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (solid-window? r c)
      (let ((color (at g r c)))
        (and (not (= color 0))
             (all? (lambda (p) (= (at g (first p) (second p)) color))
                   (positions-in-rect r c (+ r 2) (+ c 2))))))
    (define windows
      (for*/list ((r (in-range 0 (- (rows g) 2)))
                  (c (in-range 0 (- (cols g) 2)))
                  #:when (solid-window? r c))
        (list r c (at g r c))))
    (define colors (sort (remove-duplicates (map third windows)) <))
    (define dominant
      (argmax (lambda (color)
                (count-where (lambda (window) (= (third window) color)) windows))
              colors))
    (for/fold ((out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)))
              ((window (in-list windows)))
      (let ((r (first window))
            (c (second window))
            (color (third window)))
        (if (= color dominant)
            (paint-cells out
                         (list (list r c)
                               (list r (+ c 2))
                               (list (+ r 2) c)
                               (list (+ r 2) (+ c 2)))
                         color)
            out)))))
